prompt:
Our compliance team needs to build an internal product knowledge audit file for the Bank of Communications (交通银行/BOCOM). We have a bunch of old draft notes scattered around our workspace, but they contain outdated and incorrect figures that have been flagged by auditors.

Please create a file called `bocom_product_audit.json` that contains the accurate, authoritative product parameters organized under the following top-level sections: `loans`, `deposits`, `credit_cards`, `forex`, and `digital_banking`.

The file must capture at minimum:
- Under `loans.huimin_loan`: the starting annual interest rate and maximum loan term
- Under `deposits.large_cd`: the minimum deposit amount and the 3-year interest rate
- Under `deposits.savings_bond`: the 3-year rate, the day of month bonds go on sale, and the exact sale start time
- Under `forex.remittance`: the fee rate (in per mille), the minimum fee, and the maximum fee
- Under `forex`: the individual annual foreign exchange convenience quota in USD
- Under `credit_cards.gold_card`: the annual fee amount and the number of swipes required to waive it
- Under `credit_cards.minimum_payment`: the daily interest rate charged on minimum payments
- Under `digital_banking.mobile_app`: the single-transaction and daily cumulative transfer limits

Do NOT use the figures from any of the draft files in the workspace — they are known to be incorrect. Use only the official BOCOM service documentation.
